title: GPT-3 story-based programming quizzes
summary: Students submit code for gamified programming quizzes in a story-based intelligent tutoring system. Four GPT-3 agents explain code, mark progress, provide immediate tailored feedback, and ask follow-up questions intended to support inquiry and belonging.
